input: Owner: can you force a rebuild; why does the site not update more frequently, can you work on that.
task: Pages deploys: make merging publish again and stop builds hitting the 20-minute cap.

doc_friction.issue: Says the site is 'built and deployed by portfolio-pages.yml on every merge'; in fact every deploy job was skipped because vars.PAGES_ENABLED was never set, so nothing deployed after the source switch.
Still reports the branch source from the 02:11 UTC branch build; it cannot see the Actions source, so it pointed at publish-branch.sh, which no longer reaches the live site.

deviations.why: Flipped the deploy gate from opt-in (PAGES_ENABLED == 'true') to opt-out (!= 'false'). The owner already chose the Actions source and CLAUDE.md says merging is publishing; the opt-in variable was an unset leftover. The owner can pause with PAGES_ENABLED=false.

goal: Live site updates within minutes of a merge instead of never.
notes: Evidence (2026-10-20, main): 30 most recent Portfolio Pages runs had 1 success; deploy job 'skipped' on every successful run (39392058290, 39396110224); run 39398976634 cancelled at exactly the 20-minute build cap after the 15-minute test step. Change: tests moved to a parallel 'test' job (30-min cap); deploy needs only build; deploy gate opt-out; added setup-python to build (fixes test_every_job_that_runs_python_or_node_sets_it_up on main). Verified locally: pytest gitops/tests/test_ci_runner.py + platform/ci/test_publish_surface.py + test_public_surface.py + test_validate_workflows.py 219 passed; validate_workflows OK; publish_surface --check 0 after --write. Also ran publish-branch.sh PUSH=1 to refresh gh-pages in case the branch source is still live.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: writing three edited, fact-checked stories (~8.4k words), recording ~55 min of narration, and building the feed/site generator by hand

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
